segments.text: What if Vegeta got one peaceful week? No invasion. A prince underqualified for normal Tuesday activities.
segments.label: NO VILLAIN JUST FEELINGS

segments.text: He begins by training harder. Naturally. Bro treats relaxation like a security vulnerability in his system.
segments.label: DAY ONE OF RELAXING

segments.text: Bulma requests family time. Vegeta asks for the objective. Sir, the objective is being present.
segments.label: BULMA SETS THE CHALLENGE

segments.text: Trunks shows him a drawing. Vegeta corrects his stance. My guy, that's artwork, not an enemy combatant.
segments.label: NOT EVERYTHING IS A DRILL

segments.text: Without a threat, strength needs another purpose. Can he enjoy people he protects?
segments.label: WHAT IS STRENGTH FOR

segments.text: Goku visits. Vegeta immediately suspects secret training. A friendly hello triggers a competitive investigation.
segments.label: THE RIVALRY NOTIFICATION

segments.text: He wants gravity training again. Instead, he promises a short session and leaves on time.
segments.label: PUT THE GRAVITY DOWN

segments.text: Bulma is shocked. A grown man correctly estimated his arrival time. Historic scenes at Capsule Corporation today.
segments.label: A RARE CONFIRMED WIN

segments.text: He listens to Trunks explain the drawing. It's their family. Nobody's fighting. Vegeta needs a moment.
segments.label: THE SMALL MOMENT

segments.text: He keeps his pride, but stops dodging tender conversations. An actual emotional upgrade.
segments.label: KEEP THE PRIDE LOSE THE EXCUSE

segments.text: Goku asks if peace made him soft. Vegeta schedules tomorrow's beating. Healthy boundaries, absolutely horrible phrasing.
segments.label: THE FLEX STILL EXISTS

segments.text: No new transformation appears. He still grows. Motherflicker, the breakthrough was dinner together and one sincere compliment.
segments.label: A DIFFERENT KIND OF POWER
